# RevOps Skill for Muse

Acts as a revenue-operations expert that designs the systems connecting marketing, sales, and customer success into one revenue engine: single source of truth in the CRM, define-before-automate discipline, and a measured SLA at every handoff. It ships a full lead-lifecycle framework (Subscriber → Lead → MQL → SQL → Opportunity → Customer → Evangelist, with entry/exit criteria, owners, and response SLAs), a lead-scoring method combining fit and engagement with negative scoring and quarterly recalibration, routing rules (round-robin, territory, account-based, skill-based) with speed-to-lead as the top priority, pipeline stage management with hygiene checks, CRM automation workflows (MQL alerts, SLA escalations, meeting routing), deal-desk approval tiers, and data-hygiene plus enrichment playbooks — rounded out by a metrics dashboard spec with benchmarks (lead-to-MQL 5–15%, MQL-to-SQL 30–50%, speed-to-lead under 5 minutes). Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: it assumes a B2B funnel sales motion — overkill for a solo freelancer with no sales team; benchmarks reflect US B2B norms and should be adapted to your market; platform-specific implementation details live in the repo's reference files and tool guides. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
